lists.content:

  • Act as the primary relationship owner for French key accounts, preparing joint business plans and following up for sustainable growth.
  • Partner with internal P&L, finance, and legal teams to negotiate commission structures, financial projections, and margin optimizations to drive profitable growth.
  • Collaborate with marketing, category, and creative teams to build go-to-market visibility plans, exclusive capsule launches, and on-site brand positioning aligned with luxury standards.

  • Established C-level network across French luxury maisons, contemporary brands, and commercial/e-commerce decision-makers in Paris.
  • Solid commercial and financial acumen with proven experience structuring complex deal models, commission structures, and margin/P&L projections.
  • Deep understanding of luxury e-commerce operations, cross-border logistics, and brand equity protection across full-price and off-price ecosystems.
  • Entrepreneurial, self-driven mindset comfortable operating with high autonomy in a remote set-up while navigating cross-cultural internal stakeholders.
  • Excellent negotiation, communication, and executive presentation capabilities.
  • Native or professional proficiency in French, alongside a strong command of English, both written and spoken; knowledge of Italian or Turkish is an advantage.

lists.content:

  • Fluent written and verbal communication in English and in Romanian.

lists.content:
• Coordinate and guide the Romania E-commerce Consultancy outsourced team, setting clear objectives, productivity standards, quality expectations, and coaching routines.
  • Own seller segmentation and prioritization, focusing agency resources on small and medium-sized sellers with the highest growth potential.
  • Build and run performance-management cadences, using dashboards and root-cause evaluations to identify gaps and implement corrective actions.
  • Partner with Category and Commercial teams to translate business priorities into seller-level growth plans covering catalog selection, pricing, campaigns, and visibility.
  • Conduct regular local marketplace and competitor benchmarking, turning market insights into practical initiatives and commercial recommendations.
  • Develop scalable playbooks for seller activation, engagement, retention, and growth, balancing volume expansion with sustainable seller quality.
  • Represent the E-commerce Consultancy function in cross-functional forums, aligning stakeholders on priorities and providing data-backed updates on performance, risks, and opportunities.

• Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Economics, Marketing, Management, or a related field.
  • Experience in e-commerce, digital marketplace operations, commercial account management, or agency management.
  • Proven track record as a high-performing individual contributor with an ability to connect daily operational activity to GMV growth, seller quality, and marketplace expansion.
  • Demonstrated ability to coordinate, coach, and guide outsourced or remote account management teams without direct authority.
  • Analytical capability to interpret performance data, build tracking dashboards, and translate metrics into actionable growth plans.
  • Stakeholder management skills with the ability to communicate across Category, Commercial, Operations, and senior leadership teams.
  • Deep knowledge of the Romanian e-commerce market, local customer behaviors, and regional competitor dynamics.
  • Strong command of English and fluent Romanian, both written and spoken.

lists.content:

  • Identify opportunities to improve processes and strategies with technology solutions by benchmarking, and finding best practices,

  • Comfortable with the big picture as well as small details with a sense of analytical thinking, detail-orientation and eagerness to learn with agile mindset,
  • Passionate to working with multiple stakeholders and excellent communicator who can build relationships with a diverse set of stakeholders - numbers are key, but business can only be built with people,

TrendPay is where cutting-edge payment technology meets seamless user experience. This team designs and manages end-to-end payment solutions for millions of users across the globe. We are united by a shared purpose:To create a positive impact in our ecosystem by enabling commerce through technology.
 
We simplify every transaction and elevate user confidence through technology-driven, customer-first design.
 
We are all working with the same purpose: To create a positive impact in our ecosystem by enabling commerce through technology.

What We Offer
A hybrid working model with flexibility — a schedule that helps you find the right balance between flexibility and team bonding, including work-from-abroad opportunities and a summer working model.
A customizable FlexBenefits budget — Adjust your daily meal allowance, choose your health insurance package (and extend it to your spouse or children), and pick from additional benefits like fuel support or Trendyol shopping credits.

If this role excites you, apply now and let’s take the next step together.

About the Role
 
As a Treasury Professional, you manage and optimize daily cash operations to ensure financial efficiency and stability across the organization. You provide cash flow reporting, execute timely payments, and handle bank transfers and reconciliations. Collaborating closely with finance, technology, and banking partners, you ensure seamless integration of POS systems and accurate settlement of merchant transactions. By understanding funding and interchange structures, you help shape competitive pricing strategies and negotiate favorable terms with banks. You also play a key role in financial reporting, closing activities, and automating treasury processes through tools like SAP. Your work supports broader digital payment initiatives and enhances payment excellence across the business.

About the Role
 
As a Treasury Professional, you manage and optimize daily cash operations to ensure financial efficiency and stability across the organization. You provide cash flow reporting, execute timely payments, and handle bank transfers and reconciliations. Collaborating closely with finance, technology, and banking partners, you ensure seamless integration of POS systems and accurate settlement of merchant transactions. By understanding funding and interchange structures, you help shape competitive pricing strategies and negotiate favorable terms with banks. You also play a key role in financial reporting, closing activities, and automating treasury processes through tools like SAP. Your work supports broader digital payment initiatives and enhances payment excellence across the business.

lists.content:
Responsibilities
*Manage daily treasury operations, including bank transfers, reconciliations and related processes.
*Manage and optimize the bank commission structure through a cost-driven approach.
*Prepare and monitor daily cash flow reports, actively managing both inflow and outflow.
*Execute payments (suppliers, tax authorities, employees, etc.) accurately and on time,
*Collaborate with technology teams for POS installations and bank integrations.
*Manage settlement processes for merchant payments.
*Maintain a solid understanding of funding, settlement, and interchange cost structures for both credit and debit cards within the POS ecosystem.
*Negotiate funding costs with banks to optimize merchant pricing strategies.
*Build and maintain strong relationships with banks and financial institutions.
*Participate in financial closing activities
*Deliver accurate and timely financial and operational reporting using Google Sheets, SAP or similar data tools.
*Coordinate with technology teams to ensure accurate data tracking and reporting automation.
*Participating in digital payment system deployment & payment excellence projects.
 
Expected Qualifications
*Bachelor degree in Business Administration, Economics, Finance or related fields.
*Strong understanding of the Turkish POS ecosystem, funding costs, interchange fees, and settlement processes.
*Ideally experience at tech/payment companies, payment systems funcitons of the banks, digital platforms and operations is preferred.
*Solid reporting and data analysis skills
*Ability to adapt to dynamic and fast-paced work environments.
*Strong communication and negotiation skills.
*Results-driven and hands-on approach.
*Fluent in English
*SAP knowledge will be an asset.
*Strong understanding of financial markets (global and local market updates/ratio analysis, fixed income market, currency market, etc.).

- FlexBenefits: Günlük yemek bütçeni özelleştirebilir, sağlık sigortanı upgrade edebilir, akaryakıt desteği veya Trendyol alışveriş bakiyesi gibi ek haklar arasından ihtiyacına göre seçim yapabilirsin.
- İyi yaşam desteği: Lokasyon bazlı kurum içi doktorlarımızdan, psikolog ve diyetisyen desteğinden ve HPV aşısı kapsamından faydalanabilirsin.
- Kişiselleştirilmiş öğrenme ve gelişim fırsatları: Yıllık eğitim bütçeni ihtiyacana uygun olduğunu düşündüğün eğitim veya konferans için kullanabilirsin. LMS platformumuzdan dilediğin an faydalanabilir, yıl boyu sunulan yüz yüze eğitimlere katılabilirsin.
- İlk günden sorumluluk alma kültürü: Trendyol’da her ses duyulur ve değer görür. Sen de daha ilk günden itibaren inisiyatif alarak etki yaratabilirsin.
- Tek ruhlu, çok kültürlü bir ekip: Berlin’den Dubai’ye, Amsterdam’dan İstanbul’a... Farklı bakış açılarını bir araya getiren, start-up ruhuyla çalışan uluslararası bir ekibiz.
- En iyilerle birlikte gelişme imkânı: Anlamlı işlerde sorumluluk alabilir, deneyimleyerek öğrenebilirsin. Farklı ülkelerdeki ekip arkadaşlarımızdan mentorluk alabilir ve alanında uzman ekip arkadaşlarımızla birlikte kendini geliştirebilirsin.
- İş dışında da anlamlı bağlar: Ekip ritüelleri, etkinlikler ve sosyal aktiviteler sayesinde yalnızca birlikte çalışmıyor; birlikte gülüyor, öğreniyor ve ilham alıyoruz.

Ekip Hakkında
Trendyol Express ekibi olarak amacımız, her siparişte müşterilerimize kusursuz bir teslimat deneyimi sunmaktır. Müşteriyi her zaman odağımıza alarak; en ileri teknolojiyi, esnek operasyonel altyapıyı ve yenilikçi çözümleri bir araya getiriyoruz.
 
Hızlı ve iş birliğine dayalı çalışma kültürümüz sayesinde; veri, çeviklik ve güçlü ekip ruhu ile her zorluğu fırsata dönüştürüyoruz. Bölgesel olarak büyürken, lojistikte yeni standartlar belirliyor ve attığımız her adımda kalıcı değer yaratmak için çalışıyoruz.


Pozisyon Hakkında
Bu rol, temel olarak bir Bölge Yöneticisi (Area Executive) pozisyonu olup; Trendyol Express bünyesinde belirli bir bölgedeki tüm lojistik ağının, dağıtım merkezlerinin (hub) ve kurye operasyonlarının denetlenmesinden sorumludur.
Kısacası ana misyon; bölgesel teslimat hedeflerine ve KPI'lara ulaşmak, yeni dağıtım merkezleri keşfedip sürücü/kurye ağını genişleterek operasyonel verimliliği artırmak ve yasal düzenlemelere tam uyum içinde ekiplere liderlik etmektir. Stratejik planlama ile sahadaki birebir uygulamayı birbirine bağlayan; kritik, analitik odaklı ve liderlik vizyonu gerektiren bir pozisyondur.

lists.content:
• Bölgedeki Trendyol Express operasyonunu yönetmek ve geliştirmek
  • Hedeflere ulaşmak için bölgesel bir plan oluşturmak ve uygulamak
  • Bölgenin KPI'larını (Temel Performans Göstergelerini) takip etmek ve raporlamak
  • Ekibi yönetmek, geliştirmek; yetenekleri işe kazandırmak ve bağlılıklarını sağlamak (elde tutmak)
  • Dağıtım merkezlerine (hub) düzenli ziyaretler organize etmek ve gündemdeki aksiyon planları üzerinde ekiple birlikte çalışmak
  • Dağıtım merkezleri arasındaki operasyonel süreçleri verimli ve etkili bir şekilde yönetmek
  • Yeni dağıtım merkezleri için en uygun konumları araştırmak/bulmak
  • Dağıtımdan sorumlu sürücüleri/kuryeleri bulmak için yeni kanallar araştırmak
  • Sürücülerin sözleşme şartlarına uygun olarak çalışmasını sağlamak
  • Operasyonu yasal düzenlemelere (mevzuata) uygun bir şekilde yönetmek

• Üniversitelerin lisans bölümlerinden mezun
  • Dağıtım veya lojistik alanında 8 yıl ve üzeri ilgili deneyim (en az 4 yıl ekip yönetimi tecrübesi)
  • Bütçe, maliyet ve stok yönetimi konularında deneyim sahibi
  • Liderlik becerilerine sahip ve iyi bir takım oyuncusu
  • Güçlü problem çözme, analitik düşünme ve raporlama becerilerine sahip
  • Güçlü iletişim becerilerine sahip
  • MS Office uygulamalarına iyi derecede hakim
  • Seyahat engeli bulunmamak
